title: A study to evaluate the effect of ARGX-121 on the change in proteinuria in adult participants with IgAN
official: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of ARGX-121 SC in Adult Participants With Primary IgA Nephropathy
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of ARGX-121 on the change in proteinuria in adult participants with IgAN
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Males and females (not pregnant)
2. At least 18 years old
3. Clinically diagnosed with IgAN with biopsy confirmation
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of another autoimmune disease or known medical condition that would interfere with accurate assessment of clinical systems of IgAN
2. Has secondary form of IgAN leading to IgA deposits
3. History of Malignancy
4. Active infection of concern
5. Recent Major surgery or organ transplant
